description: Choose which inventory lots to pick (FIFO, FEFO, LIFO, fewest lots) — Allocates a demand quantity across up to 200 inventory lots under a stated policy (FIFO by received date, FEFO by expiry, LIFO, or fewest lots), excluding held, expired, short-shelf-life and wrong-location lots, in whole case multiples if asked. For warehouse and order agents. Returns the pick plan, the shortfall and a reason for every excluded lot. A caller asOf date is required (the check never

allowOverpick.description: With pickMultiple, allow the last pick to round the total up to a whole case (default false: leave the remainder as shortfall).

allowedLocations.description: If set, lots elsewhere (or without a location) are excluded.

asOf.description: Reference date, YYYY-MM-DD. An expiry date is the last usable day: a lot expiring on asOf has 0 days left.

hold.description: Quality or admin hold: never picked.

minShelfLifeDays.description: Exclude lots with fewer than this many days left at asOf (needs expiry on every non-held lot).

pickMultiple.description: Each lot contributes whole multiples of this case size (default 1).

policy.description: FIFO: oldest received first. FEFO: earliest expiry first. LIFO: newest received first. MIN_LOTS: fewest lots (largest usable first; ties by earlier expiry, then id).

name: lot-pick
